"Vendor must demonstrate integration with Customer HSM (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or higher). Keys must remain under Customer control; vendor must provide signed attestation and verification steps prior to processing test data."

Ethan (Platform): infra note: we can deploy a short-lived Private demo in eu-central and wire their HSM via VPN/peering. ETA ~36 hours if infra priority. we'll need a temp principal for handshake tests.

Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a 1-page CISO brief (network diagram, key flow, sample KMS snippet) to attach to the bridge.
Legal Bot: reminder: attestation language must avoid absolute guarantees. legal review required for any statement beyond demonstrable integration.
Marta (Security): I'll prepare a one-page attestation template + minimal redline language for the SQ.
Finance (FinOps): flag: Dedicated/Private will change costs. include a preliminary cost delta in the bridge invite.
ops-bot: BYO-KMS runbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/byo-kms-poc  checklist + evidentiary artifacts.

Marta (Security): I can join. Ethan can present deployment ETA.
Ethan (Platform): available. action items: Becca schedule bridge + request artifacts (HSM model + FIPS cert PDF, temp service account for handshake, allowed egress IPs); Marta draft attestation + redline; Diego tech brief for CISO; Lena loop finance and exec sponsor.

```
resource "kms_key" "customer" {
  origin = "EXTERNAL_HSM"
  residency = "EU"
  usage = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
}
```
